name: writes_state
description: TRUE when the tool mutates system-of-record state.

name: modifies_workspace
description: TRUE when the tool edits local dev or sandbox workspace files.

name: executes_code
description: TRUE when the tool executes arbitrary code or shell commands.

name: sends_external_reply
description: TRUE when the tool sends an external user-visible reply.

name: returns_pii
description: TRUE when the tool returns direct personally identifiable information.

name: creates_ticket
description: TRUE when the tool creates an operational or support ticket.

name: effective_from
description: SCD-2 inclusive UTC start timestamp for this tool capability version.

name: effective_to
description: SCD-2 exclusive UTC end timestamp (NULL while active).
